The Development Coordination Office stands ready to support this process.

history.administration_response: The new global and regional chapters of the management and accountability framework, together with the revised country-level chapter, were finalized and agreed by the United Nations Sustainable Development Group in September 2021. The consolidated version of the framework is available online: https://unsdg.un.org/resources/man agement-and-accountability- framework-un-development-and- resident-coordinator-system. Additional information or documents can be provided if required by the Board. The Development Coordination Office requests the closure of this recommendation by the Board.
